parameters.name: AliyunUid
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud account that is used to submit the quota increase application.

parameters.name: BatchQuotaApplicationId
parameters.description: The ID of the quota application batch.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of records that can be returned for the query.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 30.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token that marks the position from which you want to start the query.

>  An empty value indicates that the query starts from the beginning.

parameters.name: ProductCode
parameters.description:
The abbreviation of the Alibaba Cloud service name.

>  To query the abbreviation of an Alibaba Cloud service name, call the [ListProducts](~~440555~~) operation and check the value of `ProductCode` in the response.

parameters.name: QuotaCategory
parameters.description:
The type of the quota. Valid values:

*   CommonQuota: general quota
*   FlowControl: API rate limit
*   WhiteListLabel: privilege

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The approval state of the quota increase application. Valid values:

*   Disagree: The application is rejected.
*   Agree: The application is approved.
*   Process: The application is in review.
*   Cancel: The application is canceled.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun quotas list-quota-applications-detail-for-template --aliyun-uid 1350483376110000 --product-code ecs --quota-action-code ecs.c5.large --status Agree --batch-quota-application-id d314d6ae-867d-484c-9009-3d421a800000 --quota-category CommonQuota --next-token 4 --max-results 30 --region cn-hangzhou
